towns.name: Kryst
towns.summary: Kryst (74.6S 84.5E) is the jungle-island refuge founded by escaped Isparian slaves under Zenzaburou Hensu and Vanten the Archmage, built on Jojiism and the Code of Pwyll after they fled the Olthoi through a collapsing portal; they named the archipelago the Vesayen Isles after Vesayen Hylin, who did not make it through (Town Network sign). Since the Prodigal Sons event a Royal Guard detachment patrols its beach. In the DAT the village is a strip of domed, arch-fronted huts (The Wildsong Inn, The Olthoi's Eye and two more, 0x01000BFE) on a sandy beach at sea level along the north shore of a jungle island (LBs 0xE822/0xE922), with the Life Stone at the waterline, the Town Network portal on its glowing pad, a Nullified Statue of a Sclavus on a 6.8 m pedestal ringed by guardsmen, and The Magi's Refuge (candelabra-lit) and The Whipping Vine up on the jungle hill (z 18-26) behind; open sea to the north.
